description: Fetch one escrow by its base-58 PDA address, including its state as mirrored by the Escro API (it can briefly lag the chain; the program is authoritative). Amounts are in micro-USDC (6 decimals). The state decides what can happen to the escrow next. Claim a FUNDED escrow assigned to you before doing its work: until the claim the buyer may cancel it and take the deposit back, so work done before the claim can go unpaid. Read-only; needs no wallet.
name: get_escrow
title: Get escrow
